# ESP32 Marauder

A suite of WiFi/Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools for the ESP32




[![Build and Push](https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/actions/workflows/build_push.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/actions/workflows/build_push.yml) [![Firmware coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/branch/develop/graph/badge.svg?flag=firmware-unit-tests)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/tree/develop) ## Getting Started Download the [latest release](https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/releases/latest) of the firmware. Check out the project [wiki](https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/wiki) for a full overview of the ESP32 Marauder ## FCC module identifiers The Device Info screen reports the FCC ID of the radio module fitted to supported JustCallMeKoko hardware. This is the module identifier, not a claim that every carrier-board or enclosure configuration has a separate end-product grant. | Hardware | Radio module | FCC ID | | --- | --- | --- | | Marauder v8, Marauder Mini v3, C5 Wardriver, C5 LowKey, BFFB v2 | ESP32-C5-WROOM-U | `2AC7Z-ESPC5WROOMU` | | Marauder v4, v6, v6.1, v7, original Mini, Marauder Kit | ESP32-WROOM-32U | `2AC7Z-ESP32WROOM32U` | | BFFB / Marauder Dev Board Pro | ESP32-WROOM-32E | `2AC7Z-ESP32WROOM32E` | The legacy mappings are the closest modular approvals for the modules specified by the repository hardware designs. Confirm the module marking on a physical unit before using an FCC ID for labeling or compliance documentation. Third-party targets display `See hardware label` because their module or complete-device certification can vary by production revision. # For Sale Now You can buy the ESP32 Marauder using [this link](https://www.justcallmekokollc.com)
